name: Heroes Online
seoDescription: Discover Heroes Online codes to claim spins and coins that help you unlock powerful quirks and upgrade your hero in this Roblox game.
introMd: Heroes Online is a Roblox game where you play as heroes or villains with unique quirks. Codes in the game give you spins to try for rare quirks or coins to boost your progress. Using Heroes Online codes can help you get better quirks faster and enjoy the game more without grinding too long.
redeemMd:
## How to Redeem Heroes Online Codes
You don’t need to reach any level to redeem codes in Heroes Online. Just follow these steps:
1. [[roblox_link|Launch Heroes Online]].
2. From the Main Menu, find and click the Codes button.
3. Type or paste your code into the box that appears.
4. Press Enter to claim your reward.
5. Rewards like spins or coins will be added to your account immediately.
rewardsMd:
## What Rewards You Normally Get?
Codes in Heroes Online mostly grant spins or currency. Spins let you try for new quirks, which are essential for customizing your hero’s abilities. Coins and gold are the main currencies used for upgrades and purchases.

| Reward Type       | Description                                            |
|-------------------|--------------------------------------------------------|
| Epic Rarity Spins  | Gives a chance to get high-tier quirks for your hero. |
| Rare Spins        | Used to spin for less rare but still valuable quirks. |
| Coins             | Main currency used for upgrades and buying items.      |
| Gold              | Premium currency, often used for special purchases.    |
troubleshootMd:
## Why Codes Might Not Work
Codes may fail because they have expired or were entered incorrectly. Always check for exact spelling and capitalization. Some codes only work in Heroes Online: Legacy Edition, so make sure you’re using the right version. If the game is down or undergoing maintenance, code redemption might be temporarily disabled.
